title: Label-free pathological subtyping of non-small cell lung cancer using deep classification and virtual immunohistochemical staining.
authors: Zang, Zhenya; Dorward, David A; Quiohilag, Katherine E; Wood, Andrew Dj; Hopgood, James R; Akram, Ahsan R; Wang, Qiang
one_liner_zh: 该文用深度学习对非小细胞肺癌无标记自发荧光图像进行分类与虚拟免疫组化染色，属于医学影像诊断，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: The differentiation between pathological subtypes of non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) is an essential step in guiding treatment options and prognosis. However, current clinical practice relies on multi-step staining and labelling processes that are time-intensive and costly, requiring highly specialised expertise. In this study, we propose a label-free methodology that facilitates autofluorescence imaging of unstained NSCLC samples and deep learning (DL) techniques to distinguish between non-cancerous tissue, adenocarcinoma (AC), squamous cell carcinoma (SqCC), and other subtypes (OS). We conducted DL-based classification and generated virtual immunohistochemical (IHC) stains, including thyroid transcription factor-1 (TTF-1) for AC and p40 for SqCC. We evaluated these methods using two types of autofluorescence imaging: intensity imaging and lifetime imaging. The results demonstrate the exceptional ability of this approach for NSCLC subtype differentiation, achieving an area under the curve above 0.981 and 0.996 for binary- and multi-class classification. Furthermore, this approach produces clinical-grade virtual IHC staining, which was blind-evaluated by three experienced thoracic pathologists. Our label-free NSCLC subtyping approach enables rapid and accurate diagnosis without the need for conventional tissue processing and staining. Both strategies can significantly accelerate diagnostic workflows and support efficient lung cancer diagnosis, without compromising clinical decision-making.
abstract_zh: 非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）病理亚型之间的区分是指导治疗方案和预后判断的关键步骤。然而，当前临床实践依赖于多步骤染色和标记过程，这些过程耗时且成本高昂，需要高度专业化的技能。在本研究中，我们提出了一种无标记方法，该方法能够对未染色的NSCLC样本进行自发荧光成像，并利用深度学习（DL）技术区分非癌组织、腺癌（AC）、鳞状细胞癌（SqCC）及其他亚型（OS）。我们进行了基于DL的分类，并生成了虚拟免疫组织化学（IHC）染色，包括用于AC的甲状腺转录因子-1（TTF-1）和用于SqCC的p40。我们使用两种自发荧光成像方式评估了这些方法：强度成像和寿命成像。结果表明，该方法在NSCLC亚型区分方面具有卓越能力，在二分类和多分类中实现了超过0.981和0.996的曲线下面积。此外，该方法产生了临床级别的虚拟IHC染色，并由三位经验丰富的胸科病理学家进行了盲评。我们的无标记NSCLC亚型分型方法能够实现快速准确的诊断，无需传统的组织处理和染色。这两种策略均可显著加速诊断工作流程，并支持高效的肺癌诊断，同时不影响临床决策。
